messages.subject: Data load problem inside chunk
parts:
Using R Sweave in RStudio I am facing problem with this code:

<<fig, size='tiny'>>=
data(diamonds)
head(diamonds, n=3)
@

1. When I remove this code slides compile fine.

 With chunk included I get Running pdflatex.exe on leksioni2.tex...failed

2. When I run :
<<fig, size='tiny'>>=
data(diamonds)
@

seems everything fine in slide is shown the command without any results ofcourse.

3. When I run in Console :

data(diamonds)
head(diamonds, n=3)

data display fine.

What can be wrong?

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Data load problem inside chunk
parts:
It works after I comment out

%\usepackage{verbatim}

and add the frame environment around the code chunk (you also forgot
to load the ggplot2 package):

\begin{frame}[fragile]
<<>>=
library("ggplot2")
data(diamonds)
head(diamonds, n=5)
@
\end{frame}

You may also want to comment out

%\def\verbatim{\scriptsize\@verbatim \frenchspacing\@vobeyspaces \@xverbatim}

Regards,
Yihui
--
Yihui Xie <xiey...@gmail.com>
Web: http://yihui.name
